title: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You start a new term due a number of days after the invoice date and try numbers in and out of range.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Net X" in Name.
  3. Type 0 in the Days box.
  4. Replace it with 366.
  5. Replace it with 1.5.
  6. Replace it with 365.
  7. Replace it with 1.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads Net X.
  • Step 3: the message "Enter 1 to 365 days." shows under the Days box.
  • Step 4: the message "Enter 1 to 365 days." shows.
  • Step 5: the message "Enter 1 to 365 days." shows.
  • Step 6: the message disappears and the blue line shows.
  • Step 7: the message disappears and the blue line shows (1 is valid).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • User Feedback Summary: “Days out of range | "Enter 1 to 365 days." | Inline error, clears as soon as the number is valid”
  • Key Decisions: “Net terms run from 1 to 365 days.”
